title: Story premise ENT020: The Most Modest Medal
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: I insist you accept my award for not wanting awards. Takeaway/theme: Recognition can turn outward instead of becoming another contest.
description: Two rivals compete to be the most humble by awarding each other increasingly elaborate medals for modesty. Buried under ribbons, they quietly take the medals off and use the ribbon pile to wrap a gift for the event volunteer, who never entered the competition.
